description: This file defines the ReportReader class responsible for parsing and processing report data files related to engine parameters such as RPM and MAF. It includes methods for reading data, filtering invalid entries, mapping data by RPM and MAF values, and handling line processing with regex matching.

classes.name: ReportReader
classes.description: Main class for reading and processing report data files, generating data mappings, and filtering invalid data points.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for testing or executing the report reading process; currently invokes readMap with a sample filename.

methods.name: readMap
methods.description: Reads a report file and returns a map of RPM to MAF to ReportLine data structures after filtering and min/max calculations.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Converts list of ReportLine objects into a nested TreeMap structure keyed by RPM (rounded to 100) and MAF.

methods.name: findMinMax
methods.description: Calculates and logs the minimum and maximum values of MAF and RPM from a list of ReportLine objects.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters out ReportLine entries with invalid RPM differences exceeding a threshold.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads lines from a file and converts each line into a ReportLine object if valid.

methods.name: handleOneLine
methods.description: Parses a single line from the report file using regex pattern matching; creates a ReportLine if line matches the expected format.
